paper_records.title: Construction of a novel cell-based assay for the evaluation of anti-EGFR drug efficacy against EGFR mutation

source_locator.raw_value: To test the inhibition of EGFR phosphorylation mediated by EGFR TKIs, the cells were seeded at 2x10^4 cells/well onto 96-well bottom clear black plates (cat. 6005182; PerkinElmer), cultured for 24 h, and then treated with gefitinib, afatinib, or osimertinib for 1 h.
Growth inhibition assay. The growth inhibitory activity of EGFR TKIs against cells was assayed by measuring the amount of ATP in the cells using CellTiter-Glo (Promega, Madison, WI, USA).
Measurement of total and phosphorylated EGFR. Total and phosphorylated EGFR levels were detected by immunofluorescence staining.
